## Omitted / not shown
- fig3: space B (E3 V-DK replay, regime_B.json) has no per-set coherence axis in the file; omitted. Cao's rejection sampler has no point at the tight-module set type (0 matched sets). The "Level 2 as a whole" null (L2) is omitted from fig2b: it is mostly unmatched (46-55 % of plants), so its rate is not comparable.
- fig4: the E3 power at alpha .05 versus the amendment-5 verdict (.627 -> .666, .610 -> .585) is a text comparison with different denominators; not drawn. Cost as percent of site-leg catch is shown only as the gap between dotted and solid lines.
- fig5: the stratified-by-inference-level table and the component-level counts are 0 / not run, not drawn; no unit survives, so the "survives" bar is empty by data.
